sources.articleTitle: Beaconsfield mine collapse survivor Todd Russell dies aged 54

headline: Beaconsfield Mine Collapse Survivor Todd Russell Passes Away At 54
metaDescription: Todd Russell, who gained international attention after surviving the 2006 Beaconsfield gold mine collapse, has passed away at the age of 54.
aiSummaryBullets: Todd Russell has died at 54 years old following a recent period of hospitalization.
Russell was one of two miners rescued from the Beaconsfield gold mine collapse in 2006.
The 2006 rescue operation lasted for two weeks and received significant global media coverage.
aiContextParagraph: The Beaconsfield mine disaster occurred in April 2006 in Tasmania, Australia, when a small earthquake triggered a rockfall in a gold mine. The event resulted in the death of one miner, Larry Knight, while two other employees, Todd Russell and Brant Webb, became trapped approximately 925 meters underground. Their rescue mission captured significant international attention over the following two weeks as emergency responders worked to reach them. Russell and Webb were successfully extracted from the debris after 14 days of being trapped. The event remains a notable moment in Australian industrial history, often cited for the coordinated efforts required to locate and retrieve the survivors. Todd Russell died at the age of 54, only days after returning home from a hospital stay. His passing brings renewed focus to the legacy of the rescue effort that dominated global news cycles nearly two decades ago.
whyItIsViral: The news is viral due to high public search interest regarding the historic Beaconsfield mine disaster, which remains a prominent event in Australian history.
